protocol_correction: CLOEXEC EOF is no longer accepted as exec success by itself.
After prepared/foreground verification, the direct parent requires a real Linux PTRACE_O_TRACEEXEC/PTRACE_EVENT_EXEC transition before EXEC_READY and detaches immediately after acknowledgement.
Normal or signaled pre-exec exit emits EXEC_ERROR/UNKNOWN and cannot emit experiment start, payload main return, lifetime done, or input barrier.
ptrace denial and setuid/setgid/file-capability executables fail closed as unsupported/unknown rather than bypassing acknowledgement.
additional_fail_closed_observations: Bash/sh ptrace EPERM, pre-exec SIGKILL, and actual setuid /usr/bin/su requests produced EXEC_ERROR/UNKNOWN with no completion facts and no residual PID.
